title: Database Incident Response
immediate_actions: Assess impact on insurance operations and data access
Contact business users for critical data access needs
investigation_steps: Review database logs and performance metrics
resolution_steps: Execute database failover following approved procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply database patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with database vendor for complex issues
verification: Confirm with business users that data access is operational
special_considerations: Data integrity is critical for insurance operations
Coordinate with compliance team for audit requirements
Document all database restoration steps and timing
